a.xlink:title: The directories to search for an application's own translation files, in order of preference.
Loads the <prefix><_lang>.qm translation file from _directories into _translator.
Loads Qt's own translation for _lang, which covers the strings of Qt's own dialogs.
Loads the first _nameHint + language translation file found in _directories into _translator.
The candidates that actually exist, most likely first, so no caller searches a path that is not there...
Loads card databases from configured paths.
Sets the card database path provider.
Sets the card set priority controller.
